# langsmith_dashboard_json (Resource)

Manages a LangSmith dashboard from a JSON definition. Use it to manage a dashboard built in the UI: export it with `GET /api/v1/charts/section/{id}/definition`, or import the dashboard and copy the definition from state. For dashboards written in HCL, use `langsmith_dashboard`.

Only the fields set in `dashboard` are compared with the live dashboard, so values the API fills in (such as null optional fields) do not show as drift.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# dashboard.json holds a definition exported from LangSmith with
# GET /api/v1/charts/section/{dashboard_id}/definition.
resource "langsmith_dashboard_json" "from_ui" {
  dashboard = file("${path.module}/dashboard.json")
}

# Or write the definition inline.
resource "langsmith_dashboard_json" "inline" {
  dashboard = jsonencode({
    title = "Runs"
    charts = [{
      key        = "runs"
      title      = "Runs"
      chart_type = "bar"
      series = [{
        name              = "runs"
        metric_definition = { type = "count" }
        filter_definition = {
          source_type = "tracing_project"
          project_ids = ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]
        }
      }]
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dashboard` (String) The dashboard definition as a JSON object with `title`, optional `description`, `charts` and optional `layout`. Any `id` field is ignored.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) LangSmith workspace (tenant) ID that owns this dashboard. When unset, the resource uses the workspace configured on the provider block.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Dashboard ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a dashboard by its ID. After a refresh, `dashboard` in state holds the
# full definition, ready to copy into configuration.
terraform import langsmith_dashboard_json.from_ui 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
